content:
I don’t have a single “my API” endpoint you can call directly.

How you access me depends on where you’re using me:

- **If you mean the OpenAI API:** You use OpenAI’s Chat Completions / Responses API and choose a model (e.g., GPT‑4.1, etc.). Docs: https://platform.openai.com/docs  
- **If you mean this chat interface:** There isn’t a public, unique API URL for “this exact chat”; it’s provided through the app/site you’re using.

If you tell me **what language/framework** you’re using (Python/JS/etc.) and whether you want **chat, vision (images), or tools/function calling**, I can give you a minimal working example.
